description:
AI-powered next-generation cross-platform multithreaded downloader.

A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.

Join the Ghost Downloader community on Discord: discord.gg/fKfhkPumEM
Improvements 🔧
- Download sources and version checks now race in parallel instead of falling back one by one, improving speed and reliability By @XiaoYouChR
- Switched to a faster CDN for delivering updates and feature packs By @XiaoYouChR
- Updated translations (#753) By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed clipboard monitoring crashing on malformed file:// URLs By @tatakaria

- 更换更快的 CDN 分发更新和功能包 By @XiaoYouChR
- 更新翻译 (#753) By @i0ntempest
问题修复 🐛
- 修复剪贴板中格式非法的 file:// URL 导致监听崩溃的问题 By @tatakaria
